repositories.name: openclaude
repositories.summary: OpenClaude 是一个开源的编码代理命令行工具，支持多种云端 API 和本地模型后端，提供统一的编码工作流。

repositories.name: academic-research-skills
repositories.description: Academic Research Skills for Claude Code: research → write → review → revise → finalize
repositories.summary: 为Claude Code提供学术研究技能套件，覆盖从研究、写作、评审到修改定稿的完整论文写作流程。

repositories.name: OpenMAIC
repositories.description: Open Multi-Agent Interactive Classroom — Get an immersive, multi-agent learning experience in just one click
repositories.summary: OpenMAIC 是一个开源的多智能体交互式课堂平台，可将任意主题或文档一键生成包含幻灯片、测验和模拟的沉浸式课程。

repositories.name: invidious
repositories.description: Invidious is an alternative front-end to YouTube
repositories.summary: Invidious 是一个开源的 YouTube 替代前端，提供无广告、无追踪的轻量级观看体验，并支持订阅、音频模式等功能。

repositories.name: minimind
repositories.description: 🧠 Train a 64M-parameter LLM from scratch in just 2h!
repositories.summary: MiniMind 是一个从零训练 64M 参数超小语言模型的开源项目，仅需 2 小时和 3 元成本，覆盖预训练、微调、强化学习等完整流程。

repositories.name: manim
repositories.description: Animation engine for explanatory math videos
repositories.summary: Manim是用于制作精确程序化动画的引擎，专为创建解释性数学视频而设计。

repositories.name: pdf-inspector
repositories.description: Fast Rust library for PDF inspection, classification, and text extraction. Intelligently detects scanned vs text-based PDFs to enable smart routing decisions.
repositories.summary: 一个用于PDF分类和文本提取的Rust库，能快速识别扫描版或文本版PDF，并转换为Markdown格式。

repositories.name: video-use
repositories.summary: video-use 是一个开源工具，让编码代理（如 Claude Code）通过对话方式自动剪辑视频，包括去除语气词、调色、加字幕等。

repositories.name: scientific-agent-skills
repositories.description: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist. The #1 Agent Skills library for science, used by 190,000+ scientists worldwide. 165 ready-to-use validated skills plus 100+ scientific databases covering biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. Compatible with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Antigravity, and the open Agent Skills standard.
repositories.summary: 一个为AI智能体提供科学技能的库，包含163个经验证的技能和100多个科学数据库，覆盖生物、化学、医学和药物发现等领域，兼容多种AI代理工具。

repositories.name: patent-disclosure-skill
repositories.description: 中国专利.skill：专利点挖掘与交底书（发明/实用/外观）编写，通俗解读专利，嗅探政策动向，辅助审查答复。
repositories.summary: 一个辅助专利撰写与解读的智能技能，支持专利点挖掘、交底书编写、通俗解读及审查答复。

repositories.name: awesome-design-md
repositories.description: A collection of DESIGN.md files analysis by popular brand design systems. Drop one into your project and let coding agents generate a matching UI.
repositories.summary: 收集知名网站设计规范生成DESIGN.md文件，供AI编程代理生成风格一致的界面。

repositories.name: reclip
repositories.description: Download videos from almost any website. Lightweight, self-hosted media downloader with a clean web UI.
repositories.summary: ReClip 是一个自托管的开源视频和音频下载工具，通过简洁的 Web 界面支持从 YouTube、TikTok 等上千个网站下载媒体并转换为 MP4 或 MP3。

repositories.name: ECC
repositories.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
repositories.summary: ECC 是一个为 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编程代理提供技能、规则、记忆与安全配置的性能优化系统，用于增强代理的工程协作能力。

repositories.name: crawl4ai
repositories.description: 🚀🤖 Crawl4AI: Open-source LLM Friendly Web Crawler & Scraper. Don't be shy, join here: https://discord.gg/jP8KfhDhyN
repositories.summary: Crawl4AI 是一个面向大语言模型的开源网络爬虫与抓取工具，可将网页内容转换为干净的 Markdown 格式，便于 AI 处理。
